snapshot.scope: Independent Planning review of the first Managed Collection saved view: stable identity, bounded filter/sort, immutable view revision and Activity/Undo.

reviewers.independence: Planning reviewed Dataset/API/recovery/UI/Decision/trace owners; Development and UI independently own saved-view publication, Activity/Undo, presentation and evidence.

dimensions.summary: One Dataset keeps rows/revision stable while its view advances through private revisions.
Data/API/recovery/UI agree on one bounded filter/sort, authoritative snapshot and forward Undo.
PIGE-DATA-003 and E7.06 stay planned while broader view/schema lifecycle remains open.
Exact create/open/replay/stale/duplicate/ineligible, Activity and UI tests bind the slice.
Existing Collection owners and one decision absorb the slice without a new document.

verification.evidence: Strict view identity and authoritative snapshots expose no row values or storage internals.

verification.command: npm run verify:docs && npm run verify:decisions
verification.evidence: Dataset/API/recovery/UI and the existing Collection decision agree on reversible saved views.

verification.command: npm run verify:traceability && npm run verify:boundaries
verification.evidence: Planned acceptance stays open and final service ownership/LOC are inventoried.

coordination.compatibility: Existing row/field mutations stay; saved view adds one optional filter/sort without changing Dataset rows/revision.
coordination.acknowledgement: Planning binds first saved-view create/open/Undo only; rename/delete, multi-filter/group, formulas, relations and completion stay open.

nonBlockingRisks: Only current stable columns may enter the single filter/sort; Main owns view identity.
Vault, Dataset, table, revision, view, replay or Operation drift fails closed.
View rename/delete, grouping, formulas, relations and broad CRUD stay out of scope.
